gold: Short-coupled polymorphic ventricular tachycardia/ventricular fibrillation (SC-PMVT/VF) variant of idiopathic ventricular fibrillation

selector.rationale: Repetitive monomorphic premature ventricular complexes and polymorphic ventricular tachycardia with normal cardiac structure and function, and a variant of unknown significance in the RyR2 gene

rejected.label: Ventricular Fibrillation
rejected.why: Not a primary diagnosis, but rather a possible consequence of the champion condition

rejected.label: Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy (ARVC)
rejected.why: Normal cardiac function and structure on echocardiography, and lack of supportive evidence
